# Descriptions
@@ 1
Adds +15 to the caster’s melee or missile attack for the current round.
@@ 2
After casting this spell, there is a chance that the caster’s next attack
(melee or missile) will be treated as “Magic” for the purposes of resolving
criticals (usually only applicable against Large and Super Large creatures).
The chance is equal to 10% plus 5% for each round that the caster concentrates
(i.e., prays) immediately prior to preparingand casting this spell. The attack
affected by this spell must occur within 1 minute per level after this spell
was cast.
@@ 3
Caster gains a special bonus of +5 to his strength stat bonus for the purposes
of one manuever. In combat, this results in a special bonus of +10 to melee
attacks and +5 to missile attacks.
@@ 4
As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +20.
@@ 5
As Righteous Blow I, except attack is treated as “Mithril”.
@@ 6
As Righteous Blow I, except the critical is treated as “Holy” and the chance
is equal to 20% plus 2% for every extra Power Point used to cast this spell. A
maximum number of PPs equal to the caster's level may be used to cast this
spell. For example, a 6th level Paladin has a maximum chance of 20%; a 10th
level Paladin could attain a 28% chance (by investing 10 PPs in the casting of
the spell).
@@ 7
As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +25.
@@ 8
As Righteous Blow I, except attack is treated as “Holy”.
@@ 9
A bright, shimmering aura surrounds the caster. All creatures “of darkness”
who are in the area of effect must make an RR each round or receive an 'A'
severity critical (type to be determined by the GM; based upon the nature of
the creature).
@@ 10
As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +30.
@@ 11
As Righteous Blow I, except attack is treated as “Slaying” (creature type must
be chosen when spell is cast).
@@ 12
As Holy Strength I, except strength stat bonus is +10 for a manuever (+20 to
melee attacks; +10 to missile attacks).
@@ 13
As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +35.
@@ 15
As Holy Aura I, except delivers a 'B' critical.
@@ 16
As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +40.
@@ 17
As Holy Strength I, except strength stat bonus is +15 for a manuever (+30 to
melee attacks; +15 to missile attacks).
@@ 19
As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +45.
@@ 20
As Holy Aura I, except delivers a 'C' critical.
@@ 25
As Holy Attack I, except bonus is +50.
@@ 30
As Holy Focus, except attack is automatically Holy.
@@ 50
The caster exposes all within the area of effect to the raw power of his
deity. All in the area of effect suffer a +100 Fire Ball attack (centered on
the caster). All concussion damage is doubled and an extra Slaying Critical
(resolve on the Large/Slaying column of the Creature Critical Strike Table
14.5, p. 93) is delivered. The caster acts as the center-point for the blast
and is not immune to any of the damage. For the caster, no objects, spells,
etc. will protect him from the blast.
